examples: Delicious Sushi, floating in the air, cinematic, food professional photography, studio lighting, studio dark background, advertising photography, intricate details, hyper-detailed, ultra-realistic.

A fully assembled breakfast sandwich — with crispy bacon, a sunny-side-up egg, fresh lettuce, and golden toasted bread — is already falling from mid-air at the beginning of the shot, captured in dramatic slow motion. The sandwich stays intact as it drops straight down onto a dark black surface, creating a soft but juicy impact. The yolk slightly bursts and begins to ooze, bacon jiggles from the motion, lettuce gently bounces, and tiny crumbs scatter. Glossy fat droplets shimmer on the bacon and bread, and subtle steam rises from the sandwich. The camera is fixed, no movement. The lighting is sharp and cinematic, emphasizing rich textures and contrast. 5 seconds. No sound. Realistic high-end food commercial style.

A row of tacos filled with beef, lettuce, onions, tomatoes, cheese, and cilantro floats in mid-air against a black background. The tacos are the central focus and slowly rotate to the right in unison. Individual ingredients like onions, cilantro, and spice particles float and rotate slowly around the tacos, as if suspended in zero gravity. Visible fire effects glow softly around the tacos — with red-orange embers and heat waves rising from them, giving a clear sense of spiciness and heat. Light steam curls upward. The camera does not move at all — no zoom, no pan. Background stays static. Duration: 5 seconds. No sound. Ultra-realistic food commercial style, high contrast and vivid color.
